title: C*-algebraic de Bruin-Sharma conjecture
statement:
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be a C*-algebra, let $d\in\mathbb{N}\setminus\{1\}$, and let

$$
P(z)=(z-a_1)(z-a_2)\cdots(z-a_d)
$$

be a polynomial over $\mathcal{A}$ with $a_1,\ldots,a_d\in\mathcal{A}$. Suppose that

$$
P'(z)=d(z-b_1)\cdots(z-b_{d-1})
$$

on $\mathcal{A}$, where $b_1,\ldots,b_{d-1}\in\mathcal{A}$. **C*-algebraic de Bruin-Sharma conjecture.** If

$$
\sum_{j=1}^{d}a_j=0,
$$

then

$$
\sum_{k=1}^{d-1}(b_kb_k^*)^2\leq \frac{2}{d^2}\left(\sum_{j=1}^{d}a_ja_j^*\right)^2+\frac{d-4}{d}\sum_{j=1}^{d}(a_ja_j^*)^2
$$

and

$$
\sum_{k=1}^{d-1}(b_k^*b_k)^2\leq \frac{2}{d^2}\left(\sum_{j=1}^{d}a_j^*a_j\right)^2+\frac{d-4}{d}\sum_{j=1}^{d}(a_j^*a_j)^2.
$$

This is the C*-algebraic higher-order analogue of the classical de Bruin-Sharma inequality. The source states the degree-$2$ case is clear, but gives no resolution of the general C*-algebraic conjecture.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.06653

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of June 2022). “This was proved by Cheung and Ng in 2006 .”
source_name: K. Mahesh Krishna, “C*-algebraic Schoenberg Conjecture”, arXiv:2206.06653 (2022).
